name: SJP Ultrasonics Ltd
lm_rationale: Khandwala Securities Ltd. has no 2026 record on chittorgarh's SME/mainboard tracker (not searched separately but absent from top rows); ipomarkets.com's multi-year track record shows 23 IPOs handled (17 SME + 6 mainboard), +16.8% average listing gain across 13 listed issues, with 7 of 13 (53.8%) positive on listing day (QVC Exports +87.2%, Euphoria Infotech +90.0%, Kaushalya Logistics +33.3%, Sakuma Exports +20.0%, Cyber Media +25.0%, Vishnusurya Projects +7.4%, Premium Plast +5.0%) versus 3 negative (Bikewo Green Tech -27.4%, Essex Marine -20.0%, Mopshop Distribution -0.7%) and 2 flat.
valuation_text: fair P/E (12.07x pre-issue on FY26 EPS, 16.54x post-issue), P/BV 3.15x pre-issue NAV / 1.99x post-issue NAV
fund_use_text: Growth-led (capex ₹13.22 Cr machinery + ₹4.92 Cr working capital + ₹3.05 Cr GCP)
roe: 30.01% (FY26 per RHP KPI table p96); chittorgarh's KPI table shows 38.86%, the FY25 figure
ronw: 26.10% (FY26 per Basis of Issue Price p95); chittorgarh shows 28.10%, the FY25 figure
de: 0.29 (FY26 Debt-Equity Ratio per peer-comparison table p97); chittorgarh's KPI table shows 0.16, the FY25 figure
nav: ₹21.28 pre-issue (FY26, Basis for Issue Price p95); post-issue NAV ₹33.65. chittorgarh's KPI table shows ₹15.73, the FY25 NAV
pbv: 3.15x pre-issue (67/21.28, FY26 NAV) or 1.99x post-issue (67/33.65); chittorgarh's 4.26 uses the stale FY25 NAV of ₹15.73
eps_pre: 5.55 (FY26 Basic & Diluted EPS per RHP Basis for Issue Price; weighted-average EPS across FY24-26 is ₹6.06)
eps_post: 4.05 (post-issue EPS = FY26 PAT ₹524.26 lakh / 1,29,40,000 post-issue shares)
pe_pre: 12.07 (67/5.55, matches both chittorgarh and RHP's own P/E-at-Issue-Price table); P/E on weighted-average EPS is 11.06x
promoter_pre: 79.51% (Promoter and Promoter Group, RHP shareholding pattern as on the date of the Prospectus)
promoter_post: 58.00% (75,05,642 promoter shares / 1,29,40,000 post-issue shares = 57.99%, matches chittorgarh's 58%)
net_proceeds: ₹21.19 Cr net proceeds (Gross ₹23.45 Cr less ₹2.26 Cr estimated issue expenses) fund: ₹13.22 Cr machinery purchase (Milling Machines, CNC Lathe, Compressor, CNC Bandsaw, Overhead Crane, 6-Axis Robot, CO2 Laser Cutting Unit, Vibration Welders, Laser Plastic Welder etc.), ₹4.92 Cr working capital, and ₹3.05 Cr general corporate purposes (capped at 15% of gross proceeds or ₹10 Cr, whichever is lower). No debt repayment and no OFS component — this is entirely a growth-capex-led fresh issue.
key_risks: Net Debt/EBITDA rose from 0.17x (FY24) to 0.64x (FY26) as borrowings grew faster than EBITDA. A ₹20.20 lakh business-loan default (2018-19) led to two criminal proceedings against the company and its promoter under Section 138-type recovery action; one was dismissed for non-prosecution in 2022 and the loan itself was fully settled in Jan 2020, but the second case (CS/56871/2019) remains technically unassigned/pending on the e-Courts portal. There is also a ₹14.99 lakh direct-tax demand and a ₹19.00 lakh indirect-tax matter outstanding.
market_moat: SJP Ultrasonics is an end-to-end plastic-joining and industrial-automation solutions provider (ultrasonic/vibration/laser plastic welding, robotics, laser cutting) serving Automotive, Medical, Electrical, Electronics, Textile, FMCG, Toys, Food & Packaging, Defence and Education sector manufacturers on a B2B basis.
management: Promoters Jignesh Pravinchandra Parekh, Rupal Jignesh Parekh, Parth Jignesh Parekh, Parthvi Jignesh Parekh and Jignesh Pravinchandra Parekh HUF; combined promoter shareholding is 79.51% pre-issue, falling to approximately 58.00% post-issue.
prose_business: SJP Ultrasonics manufactures and supplies plastic-joining and industrial-automation equipment — ultrasonic welding, vibration welding, laser plastic welding, CNC and robotics-based automation — to B2B manufacturing clients. FY26 revenue from operations was ₹26.56 Cr, up 26.13% from FY25's ₹21.06 Cr.
highlight_dev: The bulk of net proceeds (₹13.22 Cr, 62.4% of net proceeds) funds new manufacturing machinery (Milling Machines, CNC Lathe, Compressor, CNC Bandsaw, Overhead Crane, 6-Axis Robot, CO2 Laser Cutting Unit, Vibration Welders, Laser Plastic Welder) to expand in-house manufacturing capability and production capacity at its Palghar facility.
sector_outlook: The RHP includes an industry-peer KPI comparison against two unlisted private peers (Rinco Ultrasonics India Pvt Ltd and Unique Circle Automation Pvt Ltd) rather than a market-size narrative; no independent third-party TAM figure was found in the sections reviewed.
gov_scheme: None disclosed in the sections reviewed.
peer_sentence: The RHP lists two unlisted industry peers, Rinco Ultrasonics India Pvt Ltd (FY25 revenue ₹12.21 Cr, EPS ₹75.56, RoNW 12.64%, NAV ₹597.93) and Unique Circle Automation Pvt Ltd (FY25 revenue ₹26.28 Cr, EPS ₹7,510.27, RoNW 22.41%, NAV ₹33,518.49) — both far smaller in absolute scale and neither listed, so no comparable P/E is available ('[●]^ Not applicable' in the RHP). The RHP explicitly states: 'the company does not have any peers listed on the exchanges, Industry Peer Group P/E ratio cannot be ascertained.'
verdict_reason: FY26 revenue and PAT both grew ~26%, leverage is rising (Net Debt/EBITDA 0.17x to 0.64x), the entire fresh issue funds growth capex with no debt repayment, and chittorgarh's KPI/NAV/P-BV figures on this page are a year stale versus the Prospectus's own FY26 numbers.
why: SJP Ultrasonics' FY26 revenue from operations rose 25.92% to ₹26.63 Cr (₹2,655.77 lakh) and PAT rose 25.63% to ₹5.24 Cr (₹524.26 lakh), continuing steady 3-year growth from FY24's ₹15.22 Cr/₹3.40 Cr. ROE was 30.01% and ROCE 38.49% in FY26 (Prospectus KPI table), versus the older 38.86%/50.80% chittorgarh's page shows (headed 'Mar 31, 2025', i.e. FY25 not FY26). At the fixed ₹67 issue price, P/E is 12.07x pre-issue and 16.54x post-issue (both figures match chittorgarh, since chittorgarh's separate 'IPO Valuation' table correctly uses FY26 EPS ₹5.55/₹4.05). Net Debt/EBITDA climbed from 0.17x to 0.64x over three years as the company took on working-capital and vehicle borrowings. The entire ₹21.19 Cr net proceeds funds machinery (62.4%), working capital (23.2%) and general corporate purposes (14.4%) — no OFS, no debt repayment. Promoter holding falls from 79.51% to about 58.00%. Lead manager Khandwala Securities has a positive multi-year record (+16.8% avg listing gain, 7 of 13 listed issues positive).
suggestion: Watch: the growth-capex fund-use and reasonable P/E are constructive, but confirm FY26 (not FY25) ROE/ROCE/NAV before applying, and weigh the rising Net Debt/EBITDA trend and the still-technically-pending 2019 loan-recovery criminal case as monitorables.

drhp-cache/sjp-ultrasonics-drhp.pdf (earlier Draft Prospectus, not used for figures — Prospectus is the current/final document)
discrepancies: chittorgarh's Company Financials table (26.63/5.24/8.32/20.09/10.65/5.78) matches the Prospectus's own Restated Statement of Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet for FY26 exactly (revenue from operations ₹2,655.77 lakh = ₹26.63 Cr rounded to nearest hundred; PAT ₹524.26 lakh = ₹5.24 Cr; EBITDA ₹823.81 lakh = ₹8.32 Cr rounded; Net Worth/Sub-Total Shareholders' Funds ₹2,008.99 lakh = ₹20.09 Cr; Total Borrowings ₹5.78 Cr per financial-indebtedness section, close to ₹1,580.26 lakh secured+unsecured as of 31 Jan 2026 which is a slightly different as-of date).

chittorgarh's KPI table (ROE 38.86%, ROCE 50.80%, D/E 0.16, RoNW 28.10%, PAT Margin 19.81%, EBITDA Margin 32.47%, NAV ₹15.73, P/BV 4.26) is explicitly headed 'Mar 31, 2025' — i.e. the FY25 column of the Prospectus's own KPI/Basis-for-Issue-Price tables, not FY26. The Prospectus's FY26 figures (ROE 30.01%, ROCE 38.49%, D/E 0.29, RoNW 26.10%, PAT Margin 19.74%, EBITDA Margin 31.02%, NAV ₹21.28) are more current and are what this card uses. This is the same staleness pattern seen on Dove Soft's chittorgarh page.

chittorgarh's IPO Valuation table (EPS Pre ₹5.55, EPS Post ₹4.05, P/E Pre 12.07x, P/E Post 16.54x, Market Cap ₹63.25 Cr pre / ₹86.70 Cr post) IS FY26-based and matches the Prospectus's own Basis of Issue Price section (FY26 Basic & Diluted EPS ₹5.55, P/E at Issue Price 12.07x) and the post-issue-share arithmetic (PAT ₹524.26 lakh / 1,29,40,000 shares = ₹4.05, ×67 P/E = 16.54x) exactly — no discrepancy here, unlike the separate KPI table.

chittorgarh's 'IPO Objects of the Issue' table totals ₹24.34 Cr (machinery 13.22 + working capital 4.92 + GCP 3.05 + Issue Expenses 3.16), which EXCEEDS the actual Gross Proceeds of ₹23.45 Cr. The Prospectus itself is internally consistent: Gross Proceeds ₹23.45 Cr less Estimated Issue-Related Expenses of ₹2.26 Cr (₹226.36 lakh) equals Net Proceeds of ₹21.19 Cr (₹2,118.64 lakh), which is then split exactly into machinery (13.22)+WC(4.92)+GCP(3.05). chittorgarh's separately-tabulated 'IPO Expenses' breakdown (LM fees 0.23 + underwriter 0.47 + market maker 0.09 + registrar 0.02 + auditor/legal 0.18 + marketing 0.27 + regulatory 0.10 + printing 0.02 + brokerage 0.89 + distribution 0.88 + rounding = 3.16 Cr) does not reconcile with the Prospectus's own ₹2.26 Cr issue-expense figure used in the Net Proceeds calculation — chittorgarh's itemised expense table overstates issue costs by about ₹0.90 Cr relative to the Prospectus's own headline number.

Promoter post-issue % (58.00%) is not literally printed as a single figure in the Prospectus text sampled but is derivable: 75,05,642 promoter shares held (unchanged, no OFS) / 1,29,40,000 post-issue shares = 57.99%, matching chittorgarh's 58% exactly.

The Prospectus discloses one settled-but-technically-still-open criminal proceeding (a 2018 business-loan default, fully repaid and settled by January 2020, with one of two court cases dismissed in 2022 and the other unassigned/pending on the e-Courts portal) plus outstanding direct-tax (₹14.99 lakh) and indirect-tax (₹19.00 lakh) matters — none of this appears on chittorgarh's summary page, which shows no litigation section.
